title: Module lineup
description: data/rules/modules.json: the mechanics modules data knows, in hook order (ADR-0011). Each listed module has its own file in rules/modules/ that switches it on or off (developer settings). Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative (src/Sim.Data/Modules).

order.description: Registered module names (snake_case), in the order their hooks run. Enabled modules take lineup slots in this order; at most 16 may be enabled. Every file in rules/modules/ must be listed; a registered module that isn't listed is never enabled.
